title: Manifest-to-render-proof sprite loop
intent: Turn an approved visual contract into game-ready sprite assets without treating provider success or file existence as visual proof.

nodes.description: Define style, assets, target dimensions, anchors, poses, and provider limits.
Resolve prompts and planned calls without contacting a provider.
Generate independent sprites, identity-locked pose sheets, or a seed frame and continuous motion clip.
Remove connected backgrounds, detect frames, preserve uniform scale, apply declared anchors, and assemble sheets.
Inspect the contact sheet and select useful animation moments. This aesthetic judgment is intentionally not automated.
Check opaque content, spatial drift, visual identity, frame count, dimensions, and layout.
Render assets in a representative scene and inspect the pixels before accepting the pack.

edges.when: the asset contract is ready to inspect
prompts, dimensions, or call count are wrong
a static or pose pack was assembled
the operator commits the selected animation frames
the rendered asset is wrong despite static checks

stop_conditions: a dry run reveals an unintended prompt or call count
a raw asset is missing while generation is disabled
opaque content is below the minimum
identity or spatial drift exceeds the configured threshold
declared frame dimensions or count cannot be produced
the representative render does not show the intended asset

gates.accepts: foreground content preserved while border-connected background becomes transparent
gates.rejects: an opaque provider background surviving as the sprite canvas
evidence: test/core.test.mjs: background cleanup removes the connected field and preserves the subject

gates.accepts: matching frames above the NCC threshold and inside the center-of-mass drift limit
gates.rejects: a deliberately displaced or visually unrelated frame
evidence: test/core.test.mjs: identity verification accepts a stable pair and rejects a displaced frame

gates.accepts: the declared frame count, dimensions, scale, and anchor
gates.rejects: missing raws or output that cannot satisfy the target geometry
evidence: test/core.test.mjs: pack pipeline assembles synthetic frames to exact target geometry

observability.current: Dry runs print resolved prompts; pack emits pack.json; verification emits pass/fail measurements.
observability.not_yet_claimed: The package does not yet emit OpenTelemetry spans or signed action receipts.
